purpose: Transparent composition-strategy profile for generating new nostalgic wonder/adventure MIDI without copying a reference melody.

interpretation: Major tonal centres are common, but minor or relative-minor shadows repeatedly appear.
The surface can move faster than the emotional pulse, creating motion without urgency.
The attractive quality is better represented as an arc of wonder, memory-shadow, lift, and gentle return than as generic sadness.
limitations: Automatic key and tempo estimates are approximate because the source is a mixed orchestral compilation.
Cue identities are not asserted from audio analysis alone.
No note-level reference transcription is stored in this profile.

melody.repeat_strategy: state -> repeat with one or two changes -> answer -> recombine
melody.large_leap_rule: resolve mostly by step in the opposite direction
melody.cadence_strategy: delay strong tonic closure until late; prefer soft/add-tone endings
melody.register_strategy: middle register first, one-octave lift only near the emotional peak

harmony.principle: warm major foundation with relative-minor shadows and delayed resolution

arrangement.ending: return to opening motif in thinner texture
